You never run out of ammo with martial arts. Your skills are always there, even when other weapons and ammo are not.

In addition, proficiency in martial arts tends to add proficiency with weapons. Your aim tends to be sharper. Your reaction to an enemy's movement tends to be more refined. Your awareness of your environment, the terrain, etc. is enhanced.

Not especially, if you have weapons like knives, clubs or nets then you'll likely be able to defend yourself against any martial artist as long as you don't let them close the distance. So really you'll only have to worry about being thrown about or pinned, at which point they can attempt to remove your gear and inflict some actual damage.
